nodes.name: bug_report.yml
nodes.summary: Defines the structured GitHub bug-report form for observed behavior, reproduction steps, affected product surface, environment details, sanitized logs, and a required secret-removal confirmation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GitHub Issue Forms controls and required validations to collect reproducible reports while explicitly discouraging disclosure of sensitive data.

nodes.name: config.yml
nodes.summary: Configures the GitHub issue chooser to disable blank issues and direct security vulnerabilities to private repository advisories.

nodes.name: feature_request.yml
nodes.summary: Defines the structured GitHub feature-request form for the user problem, smallest useful outcome, affected product area, and supporting evidence.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses required GitHub Issue Forms fields to emphasize problem and outcome framing before implementation details.
